patterns.note: Sections utilize full-bleed dark backgrounds with content often centered or presented in a grid, creating a high-contrast, immersive experience.
Headings are large, often uppercase, and use a thin to regular weight sans-serif font, providing an elegant and spacious typographic hierarchy.
A dominant dark background (#222222, #383838) is consistently used across sections, contrasted with white text and a distinctive golden yellow accent for calls-to-action and highlights.
A 'Browse Inventory' call-to-action button remains persistently sticky in the top-right corner of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections reveal sequentially as the user scrolls, with elements appearing to fade or slide into view from the bottom, enhancing engagement.

technique_notes: To achieve the persistent call-to-action, a fixed-position element is used, ensuring it remains visible in the top-right corner of the browser viewport regardless of scroll depth.

The scroll-triggered reveals for sections and content blocks are conceptually built using a scroll-detection library (like locomotive-scroll or scrollmagic mentioned in hints) that monitors element visibility and applies subtle entrance animations (e.g., fade-up, slide-in) as they enter the user's view.
Full-bleed imagery and video heroes are integrated as background elements, often with dark overlays, to create a cinematic and aspirational visual experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, often uppercase headings (~3-4x body) with a light to regular weight, creating an elegant and spacious feel.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (mostly rectangular elements and imagery, minimal rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous padding and margins, especially vertically between sections, contributing to a premium and uncluttered feel).

standout: This site distinguishes itself through its sophisticated use of a dark, high-contrast theme, which effectively highlights aspirational automotive imagery and a consistent golden yellow accent. The design masterfully balances luxury aesthetics with clear calls-to-action, creating an immersive brand experience that feels both exclusive and accessible.
